title: Simple Linear Layer
hint: y = x @ W^T + b. Initialize weight with Kaiming scaling: randn * (1/sqrt(in_features)).

description.text: Implement a fully-connected layer y = x @ W^T + b without torch.nn.Linear. Store weight (out_features, in_features) and bias (out_features), both trainable.

examples.output: y shape (batch, 2) matching manual matmul with stored W and b.
examples.explanation: Matches the standard affine map used inside nn.Linear.

constraints: Weight init: randn scaled by 1/sqrt(in_features); bias zeros.
